atoms.text: Louis Armstrong was born on the 4th of August, 1901 in New Orleans, Louisiana. He is one of the most famous trumpet players in history, and his style influenced many musicians that came after him.

When he was young, Louis Armstrong lived in a boys’ home. This is where he learnt how to play the trumpet. When he became older, Louis Armstrong began playing with King Oliver and His Creole Jazz Band; this is how he started to become famous. After he left the band, Louis Armstrong began a solo music career.

hint.text: A boys’ home is a place where troubled young boys go to better themselves through working on their behaviour and life skills.
hint.label: Boys’ home

atoms.text: In 1935, Louis Armstrong began touring through the U.S. and Europe, with big bands accompanying him. He played the trumpet and sang. Later in his life, he even acted in films. He was one of the most popular artists while he was alive, and even after he passed away in 1971, his music remained very popular. He was an amazing musician who is loved by many.
